summary: GLM-5.3-Flash: QAD TP2 preset glm53-tp2 with precision and memory options
compatibility: GLM routed experts now default to BF16 activations (W4A16) with FP32 router weights, also on glm53-spark-tp2; EXPERT_ACTIVATIONS=fp4 restores FP4 activations. glm53-spark-tp2 stays available.
details: PRESET=glm53-tp2 serves the QAD checkpoint (mtp-bf16 revision) on two 96-GB GPUs with TP2/DCP2 and MTP3: attention, shared experts and the vision tower load as MXFP8, the MTP experts as NVFP4 and the routed-expert scales are compressed losslessly, which leaves about 2.1M KV tokens (1.87M with LMCache, on by default with a 64 GiB RAM tier).

New options: EXPERT_ACTIVATIONS (bf16, fp4), ROUTER_WEIGHTS (fp32, bf16), EXPERT_SCALE_COMPRESSION (lossless, off), MXFP8_KDA_ATTENTION, MXFP8_MLA_ATTENTION, MXFP8_SHARED_EXPERTS, MXFP8_VISION and MTP_EXPERTS (checkpoint, nvfp4). Turning a memory saving off on glm53-tp2 shrinks its KV cache by the measured amount.

Measured on two RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: glm53-tp2 answers 500 of 500 needle-checksum probes exactly; compared with the Spark preset's former FP4 activations, decode at 8 requests is about 9% slower, mostly because compressed scales are expanded in a separate pass with BF16 activations, and prefill about 21% slower.
